name: haxtheweb/art
description: Artwork for HAX (haxtheweb.org). The World Traveler is HAX's mascot: a red-helmeted time traveler in steampunk goggles who carries the best ideas of every era into the future.
license_status: proposed CC BY 4.0 for artwork (see LICENSING.md); repo LICENSE file is still Apache-2.0

character.name: World Traveler
character.tagline: Dream it, remix it, have it, share it.

world_traveler.title: Android portrait
world_traveler.alt: Red android-style face with glowing cyan goggles, a HAX band across the brow and a gold lightbulb on the forehead.

world_traveler.title: Glitch double-exposure badge
world_traveler.alt: Starburst badge with the traveler duplicated and glitching, several HAX visors overlapping.

world_traveler.title: Egyptian wall
world_traveler.alt: The traveler drawn on a torch-lit hieroglyph wall, lit by a flashlight beam, with a second figure at lower right.
world_traveler.notes: Shows the 'takes the best ideas from every era' theme.

world_traveler.title: Wide-eyed panic
world_traveler.alt: Starburst badge: the traveler with wide eyes and gritted teeth behind cyan goggles.
world_traveler.third_party_reference: Cartoon style resembles a popular animated series (unconfirmed)

world_traveler.title: This is fine
world_traveler.alt: The traveler sits calmly on a stool in a burning living room, lightbulb glowing.
world_traveler.third_party_reference: Reproduces a well-known 'this is fine' meme composition

world_traveler.title: Helmet icon (checkerboard)
world_traveler.alt: Orange helmet icon with HAX band, green goggles and a lightbulb on top, on a checkerboard background.
world_traveler.notes: JPEG cannot be transparent: the checkerboard is baked into the pixels. Prefer 17/20 or the SVG logo for clean use.

world_traveler.title: Tiger in a HAX hoodie
world_traveler.alt: Line-art tiger wearing goggles, a red HAX hoodie and a green backpack with a lightbulb, standing in a child's bedroom.

world_traveler.title: Cyberpunk traveler
world_traveler.alt: A man in a red HAX hoodie and goggles holding a glowing lightbulb on a cable, in a neon rain-soaked city, sword on his back.

world_traveler.title: Green helmet portrait
world_traveler.alt: Green helmet icon with a smiling human face, HAX band, goggles and lightbulb, on light gray.

world_traveler.title: Yellow-burst cartoon
world_traveler.alt: Starburst badge with a yellow-skinned cartoon traveler wearing round glasses under the HAX helmet.
world_traveler.third_party_reference: Style parodies a long-running animated sitcom

world_traveler.title: Foil balloon
world_traveler.alt: A silver star-shaped foil balloon printed with the helmeted traveler on a black background.

world_traveler.title: Paper-cut collage
world_traveler.alt: Torn-paper collage of the traveler resting his chin on his arm, red and white paper burst behind, yellow lightbulb.

world_traveler.title: Hoodie kid, tan burst
world_traveler.alt: Traveler in a red HAX hoodie with goggles and green backpack, hands on a desk, tan and orange starburst.

world_traveler.title: Lava of Deployment
world_traveler.alt: A cloaked traveler with backpack holds a glowing bulb at the rim of a volcano; title text 'Mountain of Lava' and 'Lava of Deployement' (sic).
world_traveler.third_party_reference: Riffs on a famous fantasy volcano setting

world_traveler.title: Classic burst
world_traveler.alt: The baseline look: red helmet with HAX band, cyan goggles, green backpack with lightbulb, chin on arms, white starburst in a red circle.
world_traveler.notes: Good reference for the 'standard' on-model look.

world_traveler.title: The Cheat, HAX-ified
world_traveler.alt: A yellow round creature in sunglasses wearing a red HAX hoodie and green backpack with a lightbulb; caption 'New Character: The Cheat (HAX-ified!)'.

world_traveler.title: Helmet icon, light gray
world_traveler.alt: Orange helmet with HAX band, green goggles with cyan lenses and a lightbulb on top, on light gray.

world_traveler.title: Halloween
world_traveler.alt: The traveler lies chin-on-arms on cobblestones under a full moon among twisted trees and pumpkins.

world_traveler.title: 8-bit RPG dungeon
world_traveler.alt: Pixel-art traveler in a torch-lit stone dungeon with a status plate reading 'WORLD TRAVELER, HP 100/100, MP 50/100'.
world_traveler.notes: Links the traveler to the rpg-character lineage.

world_traveler.title: Helmet icon, light gray (alt)
world_traveler.alt: Orange helmet with HAX band, green goggles and a lightbulb on top, on light gray.

world_traveler.title: Trading card
world_traveler.alt: A collectible trading card titled WORLD TRAVELER with attacks BIT HACK and HESG and flavor text about manipulating data streams.
world_traveler.notes: Card contains small, partly illegible text.

world_traveler.title: Pixel helmet face
world_traveler.alt: Pixel-art orange helmet with HAX band, green goggles and lightbulb, a smiling human face below.

world_traveler.title: Toy-brick world
world_traveler.alt: A blocky toy-style figure in a red HAX hoodie and goggles with a lightbulb on an antenna, standing on green studs under blue sky.
world_traveler.third_party_reference: Blocky style resembles popular toy-brick and sandbox-game aesthetics

world_traveler.title: Classic burst, face hidden
world_traveler.alt: Flat-vector starburst badge: helmet, goggles and backpack with the face hidden behind folded arms.

world_traveler.title: Helmet portrait, cyan goggles
world_traveler.alt: Red helmet with HAX band, glowing cyan goggles and a lightbulb on top, calm human face below, on light gray.

world_traveler.title: Web, Web everywhere
world_traveler.alt: Single-panel ink comic: the traveler crawls across a beach of sandcastles; caption 'Web, Web everywhere, but not a drop to drink.'
world_traveler.third_party_reference: Imitates a single-panel newspaper cartoonist's style and includes a visible artist-style signature
world_traveler.notes: Highest reuse-risk image: do not promote as original HAX art without review.

world_traveler.title: Layered papercraft
world_traveler.alt: Layered cut-paper version of the traveler with soft shadows under a white and red burst.

world_traveler.title: Toy-room 3D
world_traveler.alt: A small 3D-rendered traveler in a red HAX hoodie, hands in pockets, in a sunlit playroom with books and blocks.

world_traveler.title: The ocean is rising
world_traveler.alt: Engraving-style circle: the traveler surfs a giant wave above sandcastles; caption 'The ocean is rising.'
world_traveler.notes: Supports the 'data flows like water' idea.

world_traveler.title: Sticker badge
world_traveler.alt: Teal rounded badge showing a red helmet with HAX band, blue goggles and a gold lightbulb.

world_traveler.title: Pixel helmet, detailed
world_traveler.alt: Detailed pixel-art orange helmet with HAX band, cyan goggles, lightbulb and a smiling face.

world_traveler.title: Blue soda bottle
world_traveler.alt: A glass bottle of blue soda in a park, its label showing the starburst traveler.
world_traveler.third_party_reference: Uses an existing beverage brand's label layout and name

world_traveler.title: He's on fire
world_traveler.alt: The traveler dunks a basketball with flaming arms under the caption 'HE'S ON FIRE!'; scoreboard counts commits, pushes, merges, repos and builds.
world_traveler.third_party_reference: Parodies an arcade basketball game's announcer and scoreboard

world_traveler.title: I my tummy hurts
world_traveler.alt: Crayon-style drawing of the traveler looking distressed with the caption 'I MY TUMMY HURTS'.

world_traveler.title: Pixel helmet, green goggles
world_traveler.alt: Pixel-art orange helmet with HAX band and dark green goggles with cyan lenses, a lightbulb on top.

world_traveler.title: Yellow-burst cartoon (2)
world_traveler.alt: Starburst badge with a yellow-skinned cartoon traveler with wide eyes and a smile under the HAX helmet.
world_traveler.third_party_reference: Style parodies a long-running animated sitcom
world_traveler.notes: Maintainer said this one can be ignored or removed.

other_groups.description: HAX brand assets: logos (SVG/AI/PSD), stickers, banners and thumbnails, the EdTech Joker / DedSec animated GIF series, how-to and 'creating web components' graphics. Not individually cataloged yet.
Diagrams for talks: HAX history, a legend, and the class-club-lab pipeline. Not individually cataloged yet.
Primary HAX logo (vector). Also at haxtheweb/HAXlogo.svg.
